title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #2: Gulf of California head and Colorado River delta region
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#2" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Quaternary alluvium", "Mesozoic igneous rocks", "ephemeral stream", "Colorado River" and "Gulf of California", with a dashed line marking a fault along the left side. Water of the gulf appears at the lower right.
